blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks fell for a third straight session on Friday, closing at their lowest level this year as a weaker peso and a downgrade to the country’s growth outlook weighed on sentiment. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) shed 67.06 points, or 1.18 percent, to close at 5,593.49, slipping below 5,600. READ: Slow GDP growth tests BSP resolve on inflation Philstocks Financial Inc. said investors continued to take profits as they digested recent corporate earnings reports.
